history_ts_check: undo()/redo() capture the source stack before perform. The push closures read this.redoStack/this.undoStack lazily, after perform has set this.activePageId = nextAppState.activePageId, so the inverse lands on the stack of the page now shown. The loop also stops when activePageId changes (prior minor at history.ts:244 resolved). App.tsx:4517 then calls history.setActivePage with the same id, which is a no-op. record() still pushes to the active page's stacks (setActivePage runs before store.commit). No new blocker.

It therefore proves only that the scene accessor is page-scoped, not that the export action/dialog path exports just the active page.
